requirements.text: Health endpoint returns status and tool count System returns a JSON response with status 'ok' and the tools count when a GET request is sent to /api/health.
List tools endpoint returns categorized tools System returns a JSON response with count, categories, and tools when a GET request is sent to /api/tools.
Run calculator with invalid JSON returns 400 System returns a 400 JSON response with error message 'invalid JSON' when a POST request with malformed body is sent to /api/calc.

Run calculator with unknown calculator name returns 400 System returns a 400 JSON response with error message including 'unknown calculator' and list of available calculators when a POST request with an unrecognized 'calculator' field is sent to /api/calc.
Run calculator with invalid parameters returns 400 System returns a 400 JSON response with the sanitization error message when sanitizing parameters fails in a POST request to /api/calc.

Run calculator with domain errors returns 400 System returns a 400 JSON response with error message prefixed 'invalid inputs:' when the calculator function raises ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, KeyError, or TypeError.
Run calculator with unexpected error returns 400 System returns a 400 JSON response with error message 'calculation failed' when the calculator function raises an unexpected exception.
Payload too large returns 413 System returns a 413 JSON response with error 'payload too large' when a POST request to an /api endpoint has a body larger than 16 KB.

Rate limit exceeded returns 429 System returns a 429 JSON response with error 'rate limit exceeded, slow down' when more than 90 requests per 10 seconds are sent from the same client IP to the /api path.

Security headers are added to every HTTP response System adds a predefined set of HTTP security headers (including x-content-type-options, referrer-policy, permissions-policy, strict-transport-security, cross-origin-opener-policy, and content-security-policy) to every HTTP response.

Query parameter 'code' validation in api_nav System returns a 400 JSON response with error 'invalid scheme code' when the 'code' query parameter in a GET request to /api/nav is not all digits or is longer than 9 characters.

Query parameter 'q' validation in api_nav System returns a 400 JSON response with error 'query must be 1–80 characters' when the 'q' query parameter in a GET request to /api/nav is empty or longer than 80 characters.

Invalid currency code in api_fx returns 400 System returns a 400 JSON response with error 'invalid currency code' when the 'base' or 'symbols' query parameters in a GET request to /api/fx do not match the currency code pattern.

Invalid symbol in api_quote returns 400 System returns a 400 JSON response with error 'invalid symbol' when the 'symbol' query parameter in a GET request to /api/quote does not match the symbol regex pattern.

Sharpe ratio returns error when standard deviation is zero System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Standard deviation cannot be zero' when the sharpe_ratio function is called with a portfolio_std_dev of 0.
Treynor ratio returns error when beta is zero System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Beta cannot be zero' when the treynor_ratio function is called with a beta of 0.

Information ratio returns error when tracking error is zero System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Tracking error cannot be zero' when the information_ratio function is called with a tracking_error of 0.

Sortino ratio returns error when downside deviation is zero System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Downside deviation cannot be zero' when the sortino_ratio function is called with a downside_deviation of 0.

Portfolio expected return returns error on length mismatch System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Weights and returns must have same length' when the portfolio_expected_return function is called with weights and returns lists of different lengths.

Portfolio risk returns error on dimensions mismatch System returns a dict with 'error' key set to 'Dimensions mismatch' when the portfolio_risk function is called with weights, std_devs, and correlations lists of mismatched sizes.
Parameter sanitization rejects invalid params object System raises ValueError('invalid parameters') when _sanitize_params receives a non-dict argument or a dict with more than 30 keys.
Parameter sanitization rejects non-finite numbers System raises ValueError when a parameter value is a float or int with non-finite value (NaN, Inf, -Inf).
Parameter sanitization rejects out of range numbers System raises ValueError when a parameter value has an absolute value greater than 1e13.
Parameter sanitization rejects values exceeding per-parameter caps System raises ValueError when a parameter value exceeds its defined cap (e.g., years > 120, months > 2400) in PARAM_CAPS.

Parameter sanitization rejects long parameter names and string values System raises ValueError('invalid parameter name') when a parameter key is longer than 40 characters, and raises ValueError when a string parameter value is longer than 40 characters.
Server runs on port from PORT env var System (main function) starts the web server on the port specified by the PORT environment variable, defaulting to 7860.
